## 5. Exhaustive failure of polynomial differential-form heat corrections

For a compatible Hessian h=(u¹_xx,u¹_xy,u¹_yy,u²_xx,u²_xy,u²_yy), define

    X=(h₀+h₄,h₃-h₁,h₀-h₄,h₃+h₁),
    Y=(h₁+h₅,h₄-h₂,h₁-h₅,h₄+h₂).

These are the x- and y-derivatives of (z,w). A closed two-form Ω gives the corrected heat density

    B(A)[h,h]=P₀''(A)[X,X]+P₀''(A)[Y,Y]+Ω_A(X,Y).     (10)

A globally PSD (10) would prove QC by ordinary heat flow and Stokes. We prove that no polynomial Ω can do so.

P₀ is invariant under z→exp(2iθ)z, w→exp(iθ)w. This is an actual proper output/domain rotation action, so averaging a putative certificate preserves closedness and positivity. Polynomial closed forms have polynomial primitives by radial contraction; averaging commutes with this construction.

Write az=(-y,x,0,0), aw=(0,0,-v,u), rw=(0,0,u,v). Modulo exact one-form gauges, the invariant primitive components of degrees three, two and one are exhaustively

    α₃=q₀r az+q₁t az+q₂r aw+q₃t aw+q₄r rw,
    α₂=f(0,0,xu+yv,yu-xv)+g(0,0,xv-yu,xu+yv),
    α₁=(j/2)az+(k/2)aw.                            (11)

These are coefficient vectors of one-forms. Completeness follows by weights: z has weight two and w weight one. For degree three, the invariant angular terms are r az,t az,r aw,t aw, with one remaining radial cross term after removing differentials of r²,rt,t². At degree two the resonance z-bar times w² gives four real forms and two exact gauges, leaving the two displayed forms. Degree one leaves the two angular forms.

Every leading acoustic null must annihilate the whole leading density matrix if it is PSD. Substitution of the actual acoustic pairs K=U diag(1/3,1)Vᵀ and plane-wave Hessians gives the necessary identities

    q₀=q₁/8+3/2, q₂=6-q₃, q₄=0.                   (12)

Sixteen literal rational pairs suffice for these necessary linear identities; the receiver reconstructs them.

More importantly, P₀ has an actual rank-one Hessian zero at every

    A*(τ)=(-1/4,τ,-τ/2,-1/4),

in the fixed direction R=(0,1,1,0). The compatible plane-wave Hessian h*=(1,-1,1,1,-1,1) has (X,Y) proportional to R and -R. Thus the wedge term vanishes on its quadratic score. Positivity of (10) forces the entire h* column to vanish for all τ. Solving these exact polynomial-in-τ identities yields

    g=16j/3+8k/3+8,
    q₁=-32j/9+32k/9+4,
    q₃=64j/9+8k/9+12.                              (13)

"""Exact impossibility of a polynomial closed-form heat correction for P0.

The symmetry-reduced primitive classes are exhaustive modulo exact 1-forms.
This is an obstruction to this certificate method, NOT to quasiconvexity.
"""
import sympy as S
from itertools import combinations
x,y,u,v=S.symbols('x y u v',real=True);z=S.Matrix([x,y,u,v]);r=x*x+y*y;t=u*u+v*v
F=t*t+2*r*t;C=x*(u*u-v*v)+2*y*u*v;Q=S.Rational(3,16)*(r+t)
h=S.Matrix(S.symbols('h0:6',real=True))
Jx=S.Matrix([h[0]+h[4],h[3]-h[1],h[0]-h[4],h[3]+h[1]]).jacobian(h)
Jy=S.Matrix([h[1]+h[5],h[4]-h[2],h[1]-h[5],h[4]+h[2]]).jacobian(h)
def correction(P):
    W=P.jacobian(z).T-P.jacobian(z);temp=Jx.T*W*Jy
    return S.expand((temp+temp.T)/2)
def heat(f):
    H=S.hessian(f,z);return S.expand(Jx.T*H*Jx+Jy.T*H*Jy)
q0,q1,q2,q3,q4,f,g,j,k=S.symbols('q0 q1 q2 q3 q4 f g j k',real=True)
az=S.Matrix([-y,x,0,0]);aw=S.Matrix([0,0,-v,u]);rw=S.Matrix([0,0,u,v])
PF=q0*r*az+q1*t*az+q2*r*aw+q3*t*aw+q4*r*rw
PC=f*S.Matrix([0,0,x*u+y*v,y*u-x*v])+g*S.Matrix([0,0,x*v-y*u,x*u+y*v])
PQ=S.Matrix([-j*y/2,j*x/2,-k*v/2,k*u/2])
BF=heat(F)+correction(PF);eq=[]
# PSD at all leading acoustic zeros requires annihilation, not merely zero score.
for ox,oy in [(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(1,-1)]:
    for nx,ny in [(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(1,-1)]:
        U=S.Matrix([[ox,-oy],[oy,ox]]);V=S.Matrix([[nx,-ny],[ny,nx]]);K=U*S.diag(S.Rational(1,3),1)*V.T
        ac={x:K[0,0]+K[1,1],y:K[1,0]-K[0,1],u:K[0,0]-K[1,1],v:K[1,0]+K[0,1]}
        hh=S.Matrix([ox*nx*nx,ox*nx*ny,ox*ny*ny,oy*nx*nx,oy*nx*ny,oy*ny*ny])
        eq.extend(BF.subs(ac)*hh)
leading=S.solve(eq,[q0,q1,q2,q3,q4],dict=True)[0]
assert leading=={q0:q1/8+S.Rational(3,2),q2:6-q3,q4:0}
B=BF.subs(leading)+heat(C)+correction(PC)+heat(Q)+correction(PQ)
tau=S.symbols('tau',real=True);Astar={x:-S.Rational(1,4),y:tau,u:-tau/2,v:-S.Rational(1,4)}
hstar=S.Matrix([1,-1,1,1,-1,1]);eq=[]
for item in B.subs(Astar)*hstar:eq.extend(S.Poly(S.expand(item),tau).all_coeffs())
necessary=S.solve(eq,[q1,q3,f,g,j,k],dict=True)[0]
assert necessary=={f:0,g:16*j/3+8*k/3+8,q1:-32*j/9+32*k/9+4,q3:64*j/9+8*k/9+12}
B=S.expand(B.subs(necessary))
# Two exact PSD requirements already contradict one another.
B0=B.subs({x:0,y:0,u:0,v:0})
h0=S.Matrix([0,-1,0,1,0,-1]);val0=S.factor((h0.T*B0*h0)[0])
BL=BF.subs(leading).subs(necessary).subs({x:0,y:0,u:1,v:0})
hL=S.Matrix([-5,0,7,0,1,0]);valL=S.factor((hL.T*BL*hL)[0])
assert val0==4*j+3
